verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs say you can deploy private models. They describe running your own fine-tuned LLM weights on dedicated A100–B300 instances with autoscaling and a private endpoint, and the OpenAPI spec lists custom model deployments. However, the evidence is only marketing-level summaries, with no documented upload workflow, supported formats or LoRA handling. Missing for 10: a documented weight-upload process and supported formats, LoRA adapter serving, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters
